newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Motorola Israel signs $38 mln UPS deal.
newsitem.headline: Motorola Israel signs $38 mln UPS deal.

text.p: Motorola Communications Israel Ltd has signed an agreement with United Parcel Service (UPS) to supply wireless communication terminals, a company official said.
The deal is worth $38 million and was concluded in Atlanta.
The wireless terminals were developed by Motorola Israel in 1993 and have been constantly upgraded. The latest deal with UPS brings to $250 million the value of sales of the data terminals to UPS.
Motorola said that by the end of 1996 they will have supplied terminals for 80,000 UPS vehicles.
"As a result of this deal with UPS we have turned into Motorola's data communications development centre," said Elisha Yanay, general manager of Motorola Communications Israel.
Motorola Communications is a subsidiary of Motorola Inc., U.S.A..
